title: New Zealand District Health Board boundaries, 2001–2010
credit: Stats NZ; compiled and edited by Air55; based in part on 2006 District Health Board data from the Ministry of Health; via Wikimedia Commons.
altText: An outline map of New Zealand divided into District Health Board boundaries.
caption: District Health Board boundaries in force from 2001 until the Otago–Southland merger in 2010.
context: This map shows later District Health Board geography, not the census-area denominator used in the 1990s public-health analysis discussed here. It is included to show the administrative health regions that followed.
